question: Is same-day settlement approved for MYR accounts?

claims.text:
SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
Same-day settlement is approved for Singapore SGD pilot accounts; MYR accounts are outside this scope.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
An unsigned draft says MYR settlement is available; it is a proposal, not the approved operating rule.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
For Singapore weekday batches the deadline is 18:00 SGT; weekend batches have no same-day deadline.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
The proposed November hourly schedule is not approved. Current settlement is daily.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
Partner users may read approved integration eligibility guidance; incident details are not public guidance.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
If bank confirmation is absent, ask Eva for status; do not promise a completed settlement.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
The Atlas connector supports Singapore business SGD accounts, not personal accounts.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
Singapore business USD accounts require a separate connector approval; SGD approval does not include USD.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
MIG-301 is In Progress. Owner: Chen. The remaining blocker is unmatched settlement totals.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
Roll back the ledger migration if settlement differences exceed five basis points.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
Dual-region active writes were proposed but not approved; the accepted migration uses one writer.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
Webhook latency targets apply to the pilot only; no general customer latency guarantee is approved.
Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.
Describe payment-retry only within the approved pilot scope. Unconfirmed items: general availability date and expansion beyond pilot customers.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
SET-610 is In Progress because bank confirmation is missing. Owner: Eva.
